name: LDGCRM_Screen_Flow_Developer_Data_Delete_Flow
reason: OURS, but deliberately Dev-only - NOT an unrelated-app component like the rest of this file. A screen flow whose whole job is to bulk-delete Account, Partner Account, Application, Application Contact, Market Segment, Opportunity and Opportunity Impediment records. It stays Active in the Dev sandbox as a developer convenience; it must never be promoted. Removed from manifest/package.xml and force-app so it cannot be swept into a change set regenerated from the manifest, and listed here so Sync-Metadata.ps1 does not re-add it. Its ABSENCE from QA/Full/Prod is the expected state - finding it in a non-Dev org is a failure, not a note.
